entities.title: tern-android
entities.content: Android app for field technicians who record equipment inspections on site, written in Kotlin.

entities.title: Inspections
entities.content: Checklist screens filled in by technicians, stored in a local Room database until they are uploaded.

entities.title: Upload worker
entities.content: Background worker that sends finished inspections and their photos to the back office when the device has network.

entities.title: Kotlin
entities.content: Language of the whole Android app.

entities.title: Room
entities.content: SQLite persistence library behind the local inspection database.

entities.title: WorkManager
entities.content: Schedules background jobs that survive app restarts and reboots.

entities.title: Upload specification
entities.content: Retry, ordering and photo compression rules for inspection uploads.

entities.title: Upload inspections with WorkManager instead of a foreground service
entities.content: Context: battery savers killed the foreground service and uploads were lost. Decision: enqueue one unique work per inspection with a network constraint. Consequences: uploads may wait for hours on idle devices.

entities.title: Never call the network from the main thread
entities.content: Blocking calls on the main thread froze the checklist screens and triggered app-not-responding dialogs. Correct alternative: run requests in a coroutine on the IO dispatcher.

entities.title: An inspection reaches the back office exactly once
entities.content: If this breaks, supervisors see duplicated inspections and equipment is flagged twice. The upload carries the inspection id as its deduplication key.

entities.title: Ship a Room migration for every schema change
entities.content: Release 3.2 renamed a column without a migration and the app crashed on start for every upgraded user. Add a migration test per database version.

entities.title: Alert when pending uploads pile up
entities.content: Technicians worked without signal for a week and nobody noticed thousands of inspections waiting on their phones. A metric on pending uploads now pages the team.

entities.title: Photos wait for Wi-Fi on metered connections
entities.content: Current behavior: photos stay on the phone while the device is on mobile data. Target: send compressed previews right away and the originals later. Workaround: technicians connect to Wi-Fi at the depot.

entities.title: Checklist screens ignore the system dark theme
entities.content: Current behavior: forms stay bright at night. Target: follow the system theme. Workaround: none.

entities.title: A missing effect dependency keeps reading old state
entities.content: The editor toolbar kept the selection from the first render because the effect left it out of its dependency list. List every value the effect reads.

entities.title: Save drafts every two seconds instead of on each keystroke
entities.content: Context: saving on every keystroke flooded the sync service. Decision: debounce local saves to two seconds. Consequences: a crash can lose the last two seconds of typing.

entities.title: Store a compacted snapshot every hundred updates
entities.content: Context: replaying the full update history made large notes slow to open. Decision: persist a compacted document snapshot in Postgres every hundred updates. Consequences: history before the snapshot is no longer replayable.

entities.title: The browser keeps offline notes until the user clears them
entities.content: Offline notes live in IndexedDB and we assumed the browser never evicts them. Safari evicts site data after seven days without a visit.

entities.title: Turn on strictNullChecks one folder at a time
entities.content: Enabling it for the whole web app at once produced two thousand errors and the branch rotted for a month. Next time, enable it per folder.

entities.title: Gerar boletos num job assíncrono
entities.content: Contexto: a geração do boleto demorava e travava o checkout. Decisão: gerar o boleto num job e avisar o cliente por e-mail quando ficar pronto. Consequências: o cliente não vê o boleto na hora.

entities.title: No cadastro de clientes, a última gravação vence
entities.content: Contexto: dois atendentes raramente editam o mesmo cliente ao mesmo tempo. Decisão: aceitar a última gravação e mostrar um aviso de conflito. Consequências: uma edição simultânea pode sobrescrever a outra.

entities.title: Guardar a tabela de preços no cache por cinco minutos
entities.content: Contexto: cada pedido lia a tabela de preços inteira do banco. Decisão: manter a tabela no cache do Laravel por cinco minutos. Consequências: um reajuste leva até cinco minutos para valer.

entities.title: Toda escrita feita por um job roda numa transação
entities.content: Um job que caiu no meio deixou pedidos cobrados sem baixa no estoque. Alternativa correta: abrir uma transação para todas as escritas do job.

entities.title: Guardar valores monetários em centavos inteiros
entities.content: Contas em ponto flutuante geraram diferenças de um centavo na conciliação. Alternativa correta: inteiros em centavos e arredondamento só na exibição.

entities.title: Um pedido fechado gera exatamente uma cobrança
entities.content: Se quebrar, o financeiro precisa estornar manualmente. A cobrança é única por pedido no banco.

entities.title: Notas fiscais só podem ser canceladas dentro do prazo da prefeitura
entities.content: Um cancelamento fora do prazo foi rejeitado e a cobrança ficou em aberto. Conferir o prazo antes de oferecer o cancelamento ao cliente.

entities.title: O retry_after da fila precisa ser maior que o timeout do job
entities.content: Jobs longos de emissão rodaram duas vezes porque o retry_after estava abaixo do tempo de execução. Ajustar os dois juntos em config/queue.php.

entities.title: O servidor roda no fuso horário de São Paulo
entities.content: As datas de vencimento usam o fuso padrão do PHP. Se o servidor mudar de fuso, boletos vencem um dia antes.

entities.title: A conciliação de pagamentos Pix ainda é manual
entities.content: Comportamento atual: o financeiro baixa o extrato e marca os pagamentos à mão. Alvo: conciliar pelo webhook do banco. Contorno: planilha diária.

entities.title: Prepared statements falham atrás de um pooler em modo transação
entities.content: Com o pooler em modo transação, cada comando pode cair numa conexão diferente e o prepared statement deixa de existir. Desligar os prepared statements no driver.

entities.title: Pin CI base images by digest
entities.content: A rebuilt base image changed the compiler under a green pipeline. Reference CI images by their sha256 digest and bump them in a reviewed change.

entities.title: Wait for the database healthcheck before running migrations
entities.content: Migrations started while the database container was still booting and failed half of the deploys. Start them only after the healthcheck passes.
